name: Cat Cow Stretch
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly sink as you lift your chest and tailbone (cow).
Exhale and round your spine toward the ceiling, tucking your chin and tailbone (cat).
Move slowly between the two positions, matching your breath.
cues: Arch and round the whole spine
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A gentle spinal mobility drill that alternates between rounding and arching the back on hands and knees.
